text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to set up its first drug analysis laboratory next month at a cost of 140,000 dinars.
- A Japanese-GCC forum, to be held in Bahrain in 1997, will discuss ways to boost trade between the two countries, official.
- Number of ships repaired in Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard increased 17 percent in 1996 from the previous year, official says.
- Bahraini companies plan to announce their budgets every three months to keep investors informed.
